clips.title: The story
paras: Deep inside Stormwind Keep, the War Room gathers the arms, records, and charts used to plan the Alliance’s defense.

Beyond Stormwind Keep’s grand chambers, commanders turn to military logistics and high-level campaign planning. Swords, blunderbusses, and heavy artillery cannons line the stone walls. Military treatises and chronicles of past wars fill nearby tables. At the center, a large map lets commanders assess Alliance deployments across Azeroth, while the royal court handles affairs of state just steps away.
